description.html: The forest spirit is a decorative stump that combines a mystical look with the practical role of a hide. It is shaped like an old forest stump with a carved spirit face, a beard of bark and green moss details, with a branch sticking out to the side. This piece brings character and a story to the setup and easily becomes its focal point.

It can be used in both terrariums and aquariums. In a terrarium, the hollow interior gives reptiles a hide, which is key to reducing stress: an animal with access to a hide is calmer and behaves more naturally. It suits both tropical and dry desert terrariums. In an aquarium, fish use it as cover, and the earthy and green tones go well with plants and roots.

Before placing it, rinse the stump in lukewarm water, without detergents. Set it firmly on the bottom and check that the entrance to the hide is large enough for your animal. In a terrarium it is easy to clean by wiping with a damp cloth, and in an aquarium remove algae with a soft brush. It can be combined with live or artificial plants for an even more natural look.
